title: TextbookProblem
description: Standardized schema for Engineering Graphics textbook projection regression problems.

id.description: Unique identifier for the textbook problem (e.g., ndbhatt_ch13_prob01)

chapter.description: Chapter name or number (e.g., 13 or Projections of Solids)

sides.description: Number of regular polygon base sides for prisms and pyramids

baseSize.description: Base side length (for regular polygon) or radius (for cylinder/cone) in mm

topSize.description: Top side length or top radius for frustums in mm

height.description: Total axis height of solid in mm

baseRotationDeg.description: Initial rotation around axis in degrees

baseRotationRad.description: Initial rotation around axis in radians

thetaDeg.description: Stage 2 axis inclination angle to HP in degrees

thetaRad.description: Stage 2 axis inclination angle to HP in radians

phiDeg.description: Stage 3 axis inclination angle to VP in degrees

phiRad.description: Stage 3 axis inclination angle to VP in radians

distanceHP.description: Distance of lowest point above HP in mm

distanceVP.description: Distance of nearest point in front of VP in mm

restingCondition.description: Textual note on resting condition (e.g. corner on HP, edge parallel to VP)

expected.description: Key geometric dimensions read from the published textbook solution drawing.

apparentAxisLength.description: Apparent length of axis in elevation (mm)

apparentAxisAngleDeg.description: Apparent angle of axis with XY line in degrees

length.description: Overall plan dimension along Y or length (mm)

apparentAxisLength.description: Apparent foreshortened axis length in plan (mm)

apparentAxisAngleDeg.description: Apparent angle beta of axis in plan with XY in degrees

keyPoints.description: Expected 2D coordinates of specific landmark points (e.g. apex, base center)

needsHumanCheck.description: Flag indicating this problem has ambiguous wording or contradictory published dimensions in the textbook.

humanCheckReason.description: Detailed explanation of why human verification or editorial review is required.

notes.description: Pedagogical commentary, textbook methodology notes, or derivation steps.
